headline: I left Syria thinking that I would return in two weeks. That was four years ago
title: I left Syria thinking that I would return in two weeks. That was four years ago
articlequotes: [{"articlequotes":"Before the war began I had a normal life: I would wake up, go to university where I studied medicine, go out with my friends. All of a sudden everything changed. headline: Harrowing accounts of torture, inhuman conditions and mass deaths in Syria’s prisons
title: Harrowing accounts of torture, inhuman conditions and mass deaths in Syria’s prisons
articlequotes: [{"articlequotes":"The catalogue of horror stories featured in this report depicts in gruesome detail the dreadful abuse detainees routinely suffer from the moment of their arrest"},{"articlequotes":"Philip Luther, Director of the Middle East and North Africa Programme at Amnesty International"},{"articlequotes":"Using 3D modelling techniques and the memories of those who survived horrendous abuse there, for the first time we are able to get a true glimpse inside one of Syria’s most notorious torture prisons"},{"articlequotes":"Philip Luther, Director of the Middle East and North Africa Programme at Amnesty International"},{"articlequotes":"They treated us like animals.
